item_description: An open-source digital forensics platform used to examine computer storage and investigate incidents.
item_facts: Autopsy provides a graphical interface for The Sleuth Kit.
It can analyze disk images and file-system artifacts.
It is used in forensic workflows, but results require examiner interpretation.
needs_review: Verify current feature set and supported platforms using official Autopsy documentation.

item_description: A web application security testing platform from PortSwigger, commonly used to inspect and test HTTP traffic.
item_facts: Burp Suite includes an intercepting proxy.
It has both Community and commercial editions.
Testing should only target systems the user is authorized to assess.
needs_review: Verify current editions and feature differences using PortSwigger documentation.

item_description: A security orchestration, automation and response platform developed by Palo Alto Networks.
item_facts: XSOAR supports playbooks for coordinating incident response tasks.
It can connect to security products through integrations.
Its capabilities and product naming may change across releases.
needs_review: Verify current product features and naming with Palo Alto Networks documentation.

item_description: A cloud-delivered cybersecurity platform from CrowdStrike that includes endpoint protection and threat detection products.
item_facts: Falcon is a product platform rather than one single tool.
Its offerings include endpoint detection and response capabilities.
Exact modules depend on the customer’s subscription.
needs_review: Verify current product modules and naming using CrowdStrike documentation.

item_description: A software reverse engineering framework developed by the U.S. National Security Agency and released as open source.
item_facts: Ghidra supports disassembly and decompilation of compiled programs.
The NSA publicly released it in 2019.
It is used by security researchers and software analysts.
needs_review: Verify current release and supported processor architectures from official Ghidra documentation.

item_description: A Debian-based Linux distribution maintained by Offensive Security for penetration testing and security research.
item_facts: Kali includes a large collection of security testing tools.
It is maintained by Offensive Security.
Using its tools against systems without permission may be illegal.
needs_review: Verify current release details and official project description on Kali.org.

item_description: A penetration testing framework used to develop, test and execute security assessments.
item_facts: Metasploit Framework is an open-source project.
Rapid7 maintains commercial Metasploit products and related services.
A framework module can be used only within authorized testing scope.
needs_review: Verify current project ownership and product names with Rapid7 and upstream documentation.

item_description: A cloud-native security information and event management platform in Microsoft’s security portfolio.
item_facts: Sentinel collects and analyzes security data from connected sources.
It supports analytics rules and incident workflows.
Its service capabilities and licensing depend on Microsoft cloud offerings.
needs_review: Verify current feature set and product naming in Microsoft Learn.

item_description: A vulnerability assessment scanner developed by Tenable.
item_facts: Nessus checks systems for known vulnerabilities and configuration issues.
Tenable offers different Nessus editions.
Scan results need prioritization and verification by security staff.
needs_review: Verify current editions and feature descriptions on Tenable’s official site.

item_description: An open-source utility for network discovery and security auditing.
item_facts: Nmap can identify hosts and services on a network.
It includes a scripting engine for automating network tasks.
Scanning should be limited to networks where the operator has authorization.
needs_review: Verify current capabilities and license information in official Nmap documentation.

item_description: An open-source web application security scanner and testing proxy maintained by the OWASP community.
item_facts: ZAP can proxy and inspect HTTP and HTTPS traffic.
It includes automated scanning features.
Automated findings can include false positives and require manual review.
needs_review: Verify current project status and supported features on official ZAP documentation.

item_description: A data platform with products used to search, monitor and analyze machine-generated information, including security events.
item_facts: Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud are products used for log analysis.
Splunk offers security products for detection and response workflows.
Cisco completed its acquisition of Splunk in 2024.
needs_review: Verify current product names, ownership details and features using Cisco/Splunk documentation.

item_description: An open-source network threat detection engine that can perform intrusion detection, intrusion prevention and network security monitoring.
item_facts: Suricata is maintained by the Open Information Security Foundation.
It can inspect network traffic using rules and protocol analysis.
Its deployment can be configured for IDS, IPS or monitoring use cases.
needs_review: Verify current feature set and project stewardship on official Suricata documentation.

item_description: An incident response platform that helps security teams organize investigations and collaborate on cases.
item_facts: TheHive supports case and observable management.
It is designed for security operations and incident response workflows.
Product ownership and licensing have changed over time.
needs_review: Verify current maintainer, license and version details using official project documentation.

item_description: An open-source digital forensics and incident response tool for collecting and examining endpoint artifacts.
item_facts: Velociraptor uses a query language called VQL for artifact collection and analysis.
It supports endpoint monitoring and forensic investigations.
It is maintained as an open-source project by Velocidex.
needs_review: Verify current features, terminology and project ownership in official documentation.

item_description: An open-source memory forensics framework for analyzing volatile memory captures.
item_facts: Volatility can examine memory images from supported operating systems.
The project has major versions with different command and plugin interfaces.
Analysis quality depends on the memory image and correct symbol information.
needs_review: Verify current version, operating-system support and project status on official sources.

item_description: An open-source security platform that provides endpoint monitoring, threat detection and security analytics.
item_facts: Wazuh includes an agent and a central analysis component.
It supports log analysis, file integrity monitoring and vulnerability detection.
Its architecture and integrations evolve across releases.
needs_review: Verify current architecture and feature descriptions using Wazuh documentation.

item_description: An open-source packet analyzer used to inspect network traffic and troubleshoot protocols.
item_facts: Wireshark can capture packets live or analyze saved capture files.
It supports protocol dissection for many network protocols.
Encrypted traffic contents generally require appropriate keys or endpoint visibility to interpret.
needs_review: Verify current supported protocols and capture capabilities in official Wireshark documentation.

item_description: A pattern-matching tool and rule language used to identify and classify files based on textual or binary patterns.
item_facts: YARA rules can describe patterns found in malware or other files.
It is used by security researchers and incident responders.
A rule match is an indicator for analysis, not proof of maliciousness by itself.
needs_review: Verify current project maintenance and feature details using official YARA sources.

item_description: An open-source network security monitoring platform that produces structured logs about network activity.
item_facts: Zeek was formerly known as Bro.
It analyzes network traffic and records protocol-level events.
It is not primarily a signature-based intrusion prevention system.
needs_review: Verify current project description, capabilities and naming on official Zeek documentation.
